observations.behavior: Removes the agent-based, multi-turn, sandboxed workflow and its associated configuration, replacing it with a direct LLM call.
observations.code_quote: """Generating a briefing: PostHog picks the person's top reports, and one LLM call writes the text about them."""
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the agent's ability to read, reason and write with a single, bounded LLM call. This changes the execution path and removes the sandbox and agent-specific dependencies.

observations.behavior: Replaces the agent's multi-turn, multi-attempt, multi-reasoning workflow with a single, bounded LLM call, removing the agent's ability to fix its own mistakes.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the execution path from an agent that could retry and fix mistakes to a single, bounded LLM call. This removes the agent's ability to recover from errors and changes the failure behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a strict, frozen schema for the LLM's output, removing the agent's ability to choose the items and the reason for each item.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the LLM's output to a strict, frozen schema, removing the agent's ability to choose the items and the reason for each item. This changes the LLM's output and removes the agent's ability to recover from errors.

The agent is told to write a headline and paragraphs, and to link each item once.

observations.code_quote: "description": "The current user's Today briefing for this project, as shown on the Today home page: a short text about the self-driving reports that need them most (reports that wait for them, that they claimed or review, and urgent reports nobody owns), plus up to 5 items with a label, a signal and a link. A new one is written every morning from 8:00 local time. The first call of the day starts generation and returns status \"collecting\"; while a refresh is being written, the ready briefing comes back with status \"writing\" and its text. Generation takes a few minutes; call again later for the \"ready\" text. 404 when the person gets no briefing (flag off, AI data processing not approved, or out of AI credits); show the inbox reports instead. Use this to answer \"what should I look at today?\".",
